settingsGeneral.label: General settings
settingsGeneral.description: Company profile, appearance and general configuration.

settingsImpersonation.label: Impersonation
settingsImpersonation.description: Impersonate other users for support purposes.

settingsIdentity.label: Single sign-on
settingsIdentity.description: Set up the identity provider, its provisioning tokens and the roles its groups grant.

settingsAuditLog.label: Logs
settingsAuditLog.description: Read the company's journal: who did what, who logged in, who was refused. View only — the page writes nothing.

settingsAutomations.label: Automation
settingsAutomations.description: Read automation rules and their run log (View); create, publish, enable and pause them (Manage). A rule can only do what its author may do by hand.

peopleProfile.label: Profiles
peopleProfile.description: Employee profiles and personal information. Block covers blocking, unblocking and sending a password reset.

peopleAttributes.label: Attributes
peopleAttributes.description: Custom attribute groups and attributes configuration.

peopleCalendar.label: Company calendar
peopleCalendar.description: The company calendar board: who is away, and public holidays. Balances and reasons stay with Time off.

peopleLifecycleTemplates.label: Preboarding & onboarding templates
peopleLifecycleTemplates.description: The task lists preboarding and onboarding are started from.

peopleLifecycleProcesses.label: Preboarding & onboarding
peopleLifecycleProcesses.description: Running processes: start, follow, close and delete them.

reviewsForm.label: Review forms
reviewsForm.description: The questionnaires review cycles ask reviewers to fill in. Edit writes them; Manage archives and deletes.

reviewsCycle.label: Review cycles
reviewsCycle.description: Running review cycles. View sees them and who has written what, never what was written; Manage creates, launches and runs them.

reviewsResult.label: Review results
reviewsResult.description: Reading what reviewers wrote about a person, and their rating. The scope decides whose.

peopleAttendance.label: Attendance
peopleAttendance.description: Timesheets. View reads them; Edit records your own days and exports; Manage records or corrects somebody else's.

reportsReport.label: Reports
reportsReport.description: The reports tool. View opens reports shared with you; Edit creates, shares and exports them; Manage publishes snapshots outside the company. What a report shows still follows access to people and their data.

hubContent.label: Company hub
hubContent.description: News and the handbook. Everyone reads what is meant for them; Edit writes posts and pages, sees who agreed and reminds; Manage runs the hub’s settings, pins and sections.

notificationApprovals.label: Approvals
notificationApprovals.description: May mute approval notifications for themselves. Off by default: a muted approver stalls other people's requests.

notificationOrgChanges.label: Org changes
notificationOrgChanges.description: May mute notifications about departments, teams and reporting changes.

notificationPolicies.label: Policies
notificationPolicies.description: May mute notifications about policy changes.

notificationDocuments.label: Documents
notificationDocuments.description: May mute notifications about documents added to their own file.

notificationCompanyNews.label: Company news
notificationCompanyNews.description: May mute the company hub’s news: posts sent to them and who missed a page’s deadline.

notificationSystem.label: System messages
notificationSystem.description: May mute system messages. Off by default: these are the ones people must not be able to silence.

liveNote.title: Everyone who matches now, and anyone who matches later.
liveNote.body: Assigning by filter creates a live rule: people who start matching are assigned, and people who stop matching lose only what the rule gave them. A value somebody set by hand is left alone.
liveNote.bodyTemporal: Assigning by filter creates a live rule: people who start matching are assigned, and people who stop matching lose only what the rule gave them. A value somebody set by hand is left alone. Each person gets it from the day they start matching — today for everyone who matches now.

That rule keeps it; this one does not overwrite it.
preview.live: This creates a live rule — everyone who matches now, and anyone who matches later. You can find it, change it or switch it off in Settings → Automation.
preview.manual: These people are assigned by hand, once. No rule takes a hand assignment away.
